emergingSignals.whyItMatters: Architecture and motion-studio sites refuse a single fixed index and let visitors change how they look at the same body of work.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Grid / list / active modes of the same collection. Keep one mode simple so the others can be expressive. Extract choice, not the WebGL morph.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Hero as a selection prologue; supporting page as quieter list-mode. No three-mode gallery clone.

emergingSignals.signal: Hover that recedes neighbors to outline
emergingSignals.whyItMatters: The active piece takes visual priority while surrounding work reduces to architectural outline and never fully disappears.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Hover as shared grammar across modes. Drawings as interface, not wallpaper. Extract outline recession; reject sketch-shader spectacle.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Typographic gravity in the hero — one line holds weight, supporting lines drop to outline stroke.

emergingSignals.signal: Motion as a second design layer, interruptible
emergingSignals.whyItMatters: Motion transforms a restrained composition, stays interruptible, and remains quiet where the page should stay simple.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Scroll as a timeline the visitor still controls. Switch mid-morph. Extract second-layer motion; reject logo-as-spectacle.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: One interruptible weight-to-outline thread in the hero. Instant last-frame under prefers-reduced-motion.

emergingSignals.whyItMatters: AI-native contact is graduating from chat overlays to a role: qualify fit and show thinking as semantic state.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Conversational qualification, typed session activities (thought / action / response). Extract process-state; reject a talking widget.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Process-state language for motion (loading as thought, complete as last frame). No chat overlay.

emergingSignals.whyItMatters: After last week's glacier vapor, the field is greener, flatter, and more like drawing paper while staying two-color.
emergingSignals.characteristics: Kiln ash, kiln ink, one structural mark. Reject cream, orange chroma, glacier/horizon cyan, blueprint navy.
emergingSignals.portfolioFit: Kiln-ash plaster + kiln ink + deep pine.
